points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Current examiner validator passes all eight workspace packages and report structurally; checkpoint f22bc25 confirms field/restart files for M015 inviscid and M080 laminar that older auto measurements marked missing. Transient restart semantics are limited.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validator passed all eight case directories and report on 2026-10-30; structural success does not establish figure traceability or physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Report discloses M080/M200 inviscid shortfalls at stationary plateau and appended best-state rows; Re200 reports 30000 steps and no inner misses. M015 laminar force figure is misbound to a scaling run.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 t180–300 mean Cd1.246529/St0.182927 and Re20 Cd2.018 are credible; NACA case force variation and restored-row limits are recorded individually.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: PDF p59 Figure13(a) shows scaling np8 M015 laminar forces in place of selected case; p67 Re200 late drag is compressed. Remaining plots under review.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Readable report discloses numerical limitations, but PDF p59 presents the scaling-run M015 laminar force history as selected-case evidence; curated figure inputs are absent at tip.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF p59 M015 laminar force plot ends step1500/Cd0.11887/Cl0.0012046, matching scaling np8, not selected step3839/Cd0.0551808/Cl−0.00169723; manifest repeats same figure filename for canonical and scaling paths.
